summary: Compiled a 19-asset licensed media manifest for the mobile golf simulator rental site across all four requested free-commercial libraries (Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash, Coverr). All four platform licenses were verified live this session: Pexels License, Pixabay Content License, Unsplash License, and Coverr License each explicitly permit commercial use with no attribution required (sources below). True "golf simulator screen" imagery is genuinely scarce as warned — only one Pexels shot (an actual indoor bay with a projected course) and one literal Pixabay "screen golf" facility photo exist; the rest of that slot is filled with the closest available indoor/virtual-course and premium indoor-putting shots, which is the honest state of the libraries today. Party/corporate atmosphere leans on a real Topgolf aerial venue shot plus two generic-but-premium office celebration photos since golf-specific corporate-event stock is essentially nonexistent on these libraries. Background videos mix three verified Pexels MP4s (swing, ball-drop, putting close-up) with two native Coverr golf clips (aerial course, friends golfing) — note Coverr's download links are dynamically signed behind an in-page "Download" button rather than static file URLs, so the page_url is also listed as the fetch point for those two.
